outdated.reason: configureEnvironment no longer sets X-PostHog-Trace-Id for any adapter. AgentServer.stampedRunTraceId and the test "names the run as X-PostHog-Trace-Id for codex only" have been removed. Corrected body: X-PostHog-Trace-Id is not sent on any gateway headers. It must never be sent for Claude, because the gateway ranks it above traceparent and it would collapse Claude's per-turn trace ids into one id. There is currently no run-level trace id fallback. AgentServer.promptResultTraceId reads only PromptResponse._meta.traceId and returns null otherwise. If a fallback is reintroduced, resolve it in agent-server.ts, not in the Temporal forward_pending_message activity.

withTurnTraceId, AcpConnectionConfig.stampedRunTraceId and AgentServer.turnTraceId no longer exist. installWireTaps now passes the unmodified message to logWriter.appendNotification and onWireMessage. Corrected body: the three prompt-handling call sites in agent-server.ts call AgentServer.promptResultTraceId(result), which returns PromptResponse._meta.traceId or null, and then broadcastTurnComplete(stopReason, traceId). adapters/acp-connection.ts:installWireTaps does not enrich turn-complete notifications, so their traceId is whatever the adapter reported, and the Codex adapter reports none. Any future enrichment of wire messages must happen before logWriter.appendNotification, because a thread reload reads the stored copy.

verdicts.reason: This change reverts the run-level trace id fallback for Codex. It removes the `X-PostHog-Trace-Id` header from Codex gateway headers, the `stampedRunTraceId` field, `withTurnTraceId` and its wire-tap call, and the related tests. It also renames `turnTraceId` back to `promptResultTraceId`, which now returns null when the adapter reports no trace id. The rename is consistent at all three call sites, and I found no mechanical bug. The main issue is that the bug the cache note describes comes back: Codex turns will again carry no trace id, so ratings on Codex Slack answers open nothing and each Codex generation sits in its own trace. The note on the header invariant and the note mapping the trace id paths now describe code that no longer exists, so I've marked both outdated.

findings.message: This change removes the trace id fallback for Codex. Otherwise this is a regression.

verdicts.reason: The change deletes `buildPersonPropertyMergeValue` and its tests, and hardcodes `{{person.properties["${property.name}"]}}` in `emailTemplaterLogic` again. That brings back the double-quoted Liquid merge tag the cache note forbids. A double quote ends a double-quoted HTML attribute such as a link href. The property name is also inserted with no escaping, so a name containing `"` or `\` produces a broken tag. The tests that guarded this behaviour were removed in the same change. The note against importing from `products/*` is not broken by this change, since no new import is added.

Bring back `buildPersonPropertyMergeValue`, which uses dot access for bare identifiers and single-quoted, escaped brackets for everything else.
